title: Dated end-of-support notices for Client Connector operating systems and posture features

prose.text: Each notice below is what it says on its announcement date.

android-32.statement: The notice dated July 15, 2021 says Client Connector version 1.8 and later for Android will not support 32-bit devices, and that support for 32-bit is still available with previous Client Connector versions as of that date.

quotes: version 1.8 and later for the Android platform will not support 32-bit devices
Support for 32-bit is still available with previous Zscaler Client Connector versions

catalina.statement: The notice dated July 12, 2023 says Client Connector version 3.9 and later no longer supports macOS Catalina.

quotes: Zscaler Client Connector version 3.9 and later no longer supports macOS Catalina.

windows7.statement: The notice dated March 11, 2020 says Zscaler Client Connector will continue to support Windows 7 until 2021, i.e. 12 months from Microsoft's EOS date, which Microsoft announced on January 14, 2020.

quotes: Microsoft announced the End-of-Support (EOS) for Windows 7 on January 14, 2020.
Zscaler Client Connector will continue to support Windows 7 until 2021, i.e., 12 months from Microsoft’s EOS date

samsung-device-admin.statement: The notice dated August 9, 2023 says Device Admin support is removed for new installations with Client Connector 1.13 for Android, upgrades of previous releases include it until 1.14, and the enableKnox installation parameter is removed with 1.14; it advises removing Client Certificate posture checks for Samsung Android devices from ZPA access policy.

quotes: With the release of Zscaler Client Connector version 1.13 for Android, Device Admin support will be removed for new installations.
Upgrades of previous releases will include Device Admin until the release of Zscaler Client Connector version 1.14 for Android
The installation parameter enableKnox will also be removed with the release of Zscaler Client Connector version 1.14 for Android.
adjust your Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) access policy to remove these checks

android-client-cert.statement: The notice dated Jun 11, 2026 says that beginning with Client Connector version 5.0 for Android, Zscaler ends support for the Client Certificate posture type on all Android devices, superseding the announcement published August 9, 2023, which ended it on Samsung Android devices only; it says to update Private Access access policies to remove these checks before users install or upgrade to 5.0 or later for Android and Android on ChromeOS.

quotes: Beginning with Zscaler Client Connector version 5.0 for Android, Zscaler is ending support for the Client Certificate posture type on all Android devices.
This announcement supersedes the previous announcement published on August 9, 2023, which ended support for the Client Certificate posture type on Samsung Android devices only.
update your Private Access access policies to remove these checks before users install or upgrade to Zscaler Client Connector version 5.0 or later for Android and Android on ChromeOS
Failing to update these policies may result in Private Access access issues for Android users.
